reserveReview.rationale: Write-time Ethereum reads at block 25648096 (2026-07-30) on canonical USD3 0x056b269eb1f75477a8666ae8c7fe01b64dd55ecc resolved nav(), totalAssets(), totalSupply(), USD3 waUSDC accounting, Aave market liquidity, availableWithdrawLimit(address(0)), minCommitmentTime(), isShutdown(), and USD3's USDC balance. The adapter-valued snapshot resolves 90.8% Fintech and crypto credit receivables and 9.2% Aave USDC liquidity buffer, with no idle USDC, zero minimum commitment time, and isShutdown=false. 3Jane's current backing and supplier disclosures independently describe the two credit sleeves (Fintech Credit Conduits and Crypto Credit Lines) and idle USDC supplied to the Aave V3 USDC market. The on-chain snapshot supplies the dated weights; the issuer disclosure supplies the honest group identities and the immediate-liquidity claim.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Canonical USD3 on-chain accounting, valued through its waUSDC position and the Aave V3 USDC market at Ethereum block 25648096; issuer documentation for the backing-sleeve identities.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: 3Jane publishes this live on-chain view as one combined credit-receivables group. Its current public disclosure identifies Fintech Credit Conduits and Crypto Credit Lines but does not publish a dated on-chain or dashboard split between those sleeves, facility/originator weights, or individual merchant obligors. The combined group remains structured at the disclosed level; its unverified sub-split is not inferred.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The current on-chain accounting emits one credit-receivables value. 3Jane documents the Fintech Credit Conduits and Crypto Credit Lines sleeves but does not disclose their current weights or the underlying facility and merchant allocations, so no narrower dependency or obligor split is authored.
